title: Crestline Credit Card Household Reduction — Alignment Services & Plans Household Plans
content:
A cardholder household reduction takes a percentage of the line's plan price off the price of an Alignment Services & Plans household plan. It is read from the customer's Crestline Credit Card account and the late fees posted to it in the last 12 calendar months.

| Customer's Crestline Credit Card account | Late fee posted in the last 12 calendar months | Reduction, as a percentage of the plan price |
|---|---|---|
| Active | none | 5% |
| Active | one or more | 2% |
| No active account | — | 0% |

The reduction is worked out on its own, as a percentage of the plan price, and taken off the household price, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

*Hypothetical:* on a plan price of 200.00, 10.00 is taken off for an active account with no late fee in the period, and 4.00 for an active account with one.
